The editing dashboard is hosted securely by Pages CMS. Sign in with the GitHub account that owns the website repository. No editor password is stored on this public website.

01Open the editor and sign in with GitHub.
02Select The Soft Nest Edit repository.
03Choose Affiliate Products to add a product, set its retailer URL, and enable Published once ready.
04Choose Blog posts and use Related affiliate products to select the items that belong in the story.
05Save: GitHub triggers a new Cloudflare build for published content.
